name: PIASPACE
tagline: Satellite- and drone-based environmental monitoring solutions supporting smart city infrastructure.
solution_summary: PIASPACE provides an environment and energy monitoring platform combining satellite imagery with drone data. It applies to a range of smart city domains including air/water quality management, disaster prediction, and energy infrastructure inspection, offering tailored solutions for the environmental management needs of local governments and industrial parks in Vietnam.
target_buyer_display: Local governments and smart city project owners
